title: Translates along G of an action carried by G^⊥ vanish outside a compact set
statement: Let P, j ∈ ℕ and let G be a linear subspace of ℝ^P (G : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)). Let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in ℝ^P (R : IMRep univ j) whose measure R.measure = θ·μHE[j]⌞M is concentrated on G^⊥: R.measure(ℝ^P ∖ G^⊥) = 0. Let η : ℝ^P → Λ^j (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) j) be a j-form with compact support. Then there is a compact set K ⊆ ℝ^P such that R.action(y ↦ η(t + y)) = 0 for every t ∈ G with t ∉ K.
lean_statement: ∀ (P j : ℕ) (G : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) j) (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) j), HasCompactSupport η → R.measure (Gᗮ : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 → ∃ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K ∧ ∀ t ∈ G, t ∉ K → R.action (fun y => η (t + y)) = 0
